name: join-using-projections
description: Benchmark USING, coalesced shared keys and wildcard projections

queries.name: using-event-id
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a USING (user_id) ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: using-qualified-stars
queries.sql: SELECT a.*, b.* FROM accounts a JOIN accounts b USING (user_id) ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: using-shared-star
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM accounts a JOIN accounts b USING (user_id, tier) ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20
